other_conditions: The applicant must not be an employee of either Central or State Government.
The applicant must have been hospitalized or undergoing treatment in a Government Hospital (including super specialty Government hospitals/institutes).
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to ₹1,00,000 for treatment in government hospitals, with assistance ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹1,00,000 based on the estimated cost of treatment.
